title: MPBL: Cebu nips Batangas in playoff Game 1

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —Ron Dennison delivered when it mattered most, drilling a corner triple with 10.7 seconds left to lift the Cebu Greats past the Batangas City Tanduay Athletics, 78-77, on Wednesday in Game 1 of their South Division quarterfinal series in the SportsPlus MPBL 2026 Season at the Quezon Convention Center in Lucena City. The clutch basket proved even more meaningful for Dennison, who dedicated his game-winning shot to his late lola, who passed away on September 22.
